summary: Minerals Technologies Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing via Item 8.01 that it commenced a private offering of senior notes exempt from registration under the Securities Act, with a related press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. No principal amount, coupon, price, maturity or use-of-proceeds specifics appear in the excerpt beyond forward-looking references to intended proceeds. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, stake or closing date is stated. This is a routine debt-capital-markets event, not a special situation; watch pricing terms, proceeds use and leverage impact.
